back: Retelling what someone said without quoting their exact words, usually with changes to tense, pronouns and time words.
notes: She said that she was tired.

back: am/is → was; are → were; has/have → had; past simple → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might.
today → that day; tomorrow → the next day; yesterday → the day before; now → then; here → there; this → that.
asked + if/whether + statement word order, no question mark.
notes: She asked me if I was ready.
